description: This file defines the YarnClientSchedulerBackend class, which manages the interaction between Spark and YARN for scheduling and application lifecycle management in a Spark cluster running on YARN. It includes methods for starting, monitoring, and stopping the application, as well as handling application state and delegation tokens.

classes.name: YarnClientSchedulerBackend
classes.description: A backend class for managing Spark applications on YARN, including application submission, monitoring, and termination.

classes.name: MonitorThread
classes.description: Inner class for monitoring the YARN application state in a separate thread, handling unexpected exits and coordinating SparkContext shutdown.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Yarn client, submits the application, and begins monitoring its state.

methods.name: waitForApplication
methods.description: Blocks until the application reaches a terminal state or is confirmed to be running.

methods.name: asyncMonitorApplication
methods.description: Creates and returns a thread that monitors the application state asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend, signals the driver to stop, and reports final application state.
